timeline.short: A foundation in computing, systems design, and software development.
timeline.story: Completed a BSc (Hons) in Computing and Information Systems with Distinction at the University of Nottingham. The dissertation focused on an automated patient information system delivering outputs to multiple client platforms.
achievements: BSc (Hons) Computing and Information Systems — Distinction
Thesis: Automated Patient Information System
Developed a foundation in cross-platform software and information systems

timeline.short: Spatial thinking enters the story through terrain, visibility, and geographical information.
timeline.story: Completed the MSc in Geographical Information Sciences with Merit at the University of Nottingham. The dissertation evaluated viewsheds to support planning and identifying optimal hidden routes through terrain. Recipient of Developing Solution and Geography School scholarships.
achievements: MSc Geographical Information Sciences — Merit
Thesis: evaluating viewsheds for hidden-route planning
Developing Solution and Geography School scholarships

timeline.short: Where national mapping and 3D geospatial products became practical engineering.
timeline.story: Supported mapping products, moved in-house tools from MapInfo to Esri, trained developers in Python and contributed research and scripts for city-scale 3D height products.
achievements: Transitioned internal solutions toward Esri technologies
Developed workflows for city-scale 3D height products
Provided GIS product demonstrations and Python knowledge sharing

timeline.short: Spatial analysis moves into engineering, pipelines, energy and the built environment.
timeline.story: GIS support for engineering programmes, including pipeline modelling, wind-farm studies, environmental analysis, CAD data and custom costing applications.
achievements: GIS support for infrastructure and environmental studies
Pipeline modelling and CAD integration
Developed custom analysis and costing tools

timeline.short: A focused consultancy chapter within the earlier engineering period.
timeline.story: A three-month secondment providing technical GIS consultancy for oil and gas field-development planning, data modelling and future mapping-tool strategies. This engagement overlaps with the KBR chapter.
achievements: Advised on field-development planning tools
Contributed data modelling and GIS development strategy
Worked directly on domain-specific consultancy

timeline.short: GIS becomes an enterprise-wide network connecting people and places.
timeline.story: Developed a distributed global GIS infrastructure and strategy across offices, built custom applications, automated manual processes, led developers and championed technology innovation.
achievements: Designed global GIS infrastructure and strategy
Created GIS applications and real-time usage monitoring
Presented a GIS development case at the Esri developer community in 2013

timeline.short: Client-focused GIS solutions for infrastructure and utilities.
timeline.story: Provided GIS consultancy and Esri/.NET solution development for a UK power-network mapping project, gathered requirements and coordinated a small team of analysts.
achievements: Delivered Esri-based web GIS components
Translated requirements into solution architecture
Led a small GIS analyst team

timeline.role: GIS Technical Architect · Solution Architect / Engineer
timeline.short: Software architecture, modernisation and large client systems.
timeline.story: Worked on GIS architecture, client-facing engineering, legacy-system modernisation and, in 2017–2018, railway signalling visualisation and data-processing software.
achievements: Led GIS technical architecture and client projects
Refactored and modernised C# / ArcObjects systems
Enhanced C#/.NET railway signalling applications

timeline.role: Senior Engineering Manager / Architect GIS & AWS
timeline.short: From delivering systems to shaping geospatial and cloud strategy.
timeline.story: Managed technical teams, helped lead enterprise GIS and cloud strategy, improved architecture and operations, and designed applications, analytics and data pipelines.
achievements: Led software engineers, analysts and developers
Designed enterprise GIS and cloud platform improvements
Oversaw GIS architecture, streaming pipelines and analytics

timeline.short: Industrial-scale geospatial analytics in the cloud.
timeline.story: Developed Python raster-processing algorithms, cloud geospatial processing systems on AWS and strategies for scalable open-source geospatial technologies.
achievements: Advanced Python raster and spatial algorithms
Cloud-based geospatial processing on AWS
Worked across engineering, GIS, cloud and IT teams

timeline.short: The architecture of data becomes as important as the map itself.
timeline.story: Led data architects and modellers, shaped enterprise data architecture strategy, and worked with engineering teams on ingestion strategies, pipelines and complex data systems.
achievements: Led and developed the data architecture team
Defined enterprise architecture and ingestion strategy
Collaborated on data engineering and modelling solutions

timeline.short: Bringing geospatial systems, exploration and generative AI together.
timeline.story: Works on geospatial application development, generative AI applications, enterprise GIS and technical training in an upstream exploration setting. Presented a geospatial GenAI solution at Geo 4.0 in 2025.
achievements: Geospatial applications for exploration workflows
Generative AI application development and enterprise GIS
Technology training and Geo 4.0 presentation (2025)

domains.name: GIS & Spatial
domains.short: Mapmaking becomes a system for understanding the world.
domains.description: Geospatial systems, spatial analytics, terrain interpretation, enterprise GIS and cartographic application design form the core of this career.
highlights: Spatial data engineering and 3D terrain products
ArcGIS enterprise, Python geoprocessing and web mapping
GIS for exploration, infrastructure and environmental analysis

domains.name: Engineering
domains.short: Practical software built around real operational problems.
domains.description: From enterprise applications and C# systems to custom GIS integrations, reusable software patterns and engineering team delivery.
highlights: Refactoring, reusable components and delivery practices

domains.name: Cloud & Platforms
domains.short: Connected platforms that make spatial intelligence scalable.
domains.description: Design and operation of enterprise geospatial platforms, cloud processing systems, modern delivery infrastructure and scalable architectures.
highlights: Enterprise systems design and infrastructure strategy

domains.name: Data Architecture
domains.short: Complex information becomes dependable pipelines and insight.
domains.description: Data modelling, enterprise data architecture, real-time streaming, data ingestion and analytics across large technical platforms.
highlights: Data governance and cross-team engineering leadership

domains.name: AI & GeoAI
domains.short: Where location intelligence meets generative AI.
domains.description: Generative AI applications, machine learning and emerging geospatial interfaces that make sophisticated analysis more accessible.
highlights: Presentation of a geospatial GenAI solution at Geo 4.0 (2025)

domains.name: Leadership & Learning
domains.short: Technology matters most when teams can use it.
domains.description: Engineering management, technical strategy, mentoring, technology presentations and specialist training across GIS and adjacent disciplines.
highlights: Management of technical and architecture teams
Stakeholder engagement and geospatial innovation leadership
